clause.text:
3 OBLIGATIONS OF PLAN_B

 3.1 plan_b will distribute Content to End Users in the Territory through its distribution channels.

3.4 LICENSOR shall have the right to use a certified public accountant to inspect and audit all the related records and books of plan_b to ensure plan_b's compliance with the terms of this Agreement. clause.heading: 3.4 LICENSOR shall have the right to use a certified public accountant to inspect and audit all the related records and books of plan_b to ensure plan_b's compliance with the terms of this Agreement. In the event that any such audit reveals that plan_b has underpaid fees to the value of ten (10) percent or more of the total amount of payments for the period covered by the audit, plan_b shall bear the cost of the audit and shall in any event immediately pay to LICENSOR

reviews.rationale: The clause allows unlimited audits with no notice period and shifts audit cost to plan_b only when underpayment reaches 10%. This exceeds the playbook's bounded audit rights (once per 12 months, 30‑day notice, auditor bears cost) and the fallback cost provision (cost only if underpayment >5%). The broader scope and higher cost threshold introduce a material deviation, yielding a medium risk.

citations.excerpt: A party may audit the other party's records relevant to this Agreement no more than once in any twelve (12) month period, on thirty (30) days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, at the auditing party's cost, and subject to the confidentiality obligations in this Agreement.

reviews.suggested_fallback: A party may audit the other party's records relevant to this Agreement no more than twice in any twelve (12) month period, on fifteen (15) days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and subject to the confidentiality obligations in this Agreement. The audited party bears the cost only if the audit reveals an underpayment of more than five percent (5%).
reviews.verification_reason: The reviewer correctly identifies that the clause permits unlimited audits without notice and shifts cost to plan_b only when underpayment reaches 10%, which deviates from the playbook's preferred limit of one audit per 12 months with 30‑day notice and audit cost normally borne by the auditor. The suggested fallback text matches the playbook fallback verbatim. Therefore the claims are supported and the risk level of medium is justified.

clause.text:
6.1 Each Party shall keep in confidence all material and information, including without limitation Content, received from the other Party and marked as confidential or which should be understood to be confidential, and may not use such material or information for any other purposes than those set forth in this Agreement. The confidentiality obligation shall, however, not be applied to material and information, which as shown by the receiving Party,

 6.1.1 is generally available or otherwise public; or

 6.1.2 the receiving Party has received from a third party without any obligation of confidentiality; or

 6.1.3 was in the possession of the receiving Party prior to receipt of the same from the other Party without any obligation of confidentiality related thereto; or

 6.1.4 the receiving party has independently developed without using material or information received from the other Party.
